status: FROZEN BEFORE ANY NEW FIT AND BEFORE ANY NEW ACS PERFORMANCE OUTCOME

constants.degenerate_convention: nondividing: drop degenerate block, reweight survivor to 1.0; both degenerate -> D_j:=0; lin reference degenerate -> c_j:=0
constants.quadratic_scale: one scalar per role per block from the common reference projection
constants.selection: lowest training objective only; no attacker/residence/commute/outcome consulted

declared_tolerances.expected_fp_error_note: sqrt(n)*eps ~ 2.3e-14 for n=1.05e4 float64 pairwise summation; O(r*eps) ~ 3.5e-15 for the r x r conjugation

acceptance_gate.timing: computed after fitting and BEFORE any 2018 score is read
acceptance_gate.on_failure: repaired arm is not scored; misspecification is the reportable result; baselines and evidence work continue

registered_forecasts.Q1: rotation-only share < 0.01 in every seed, rank, policy (structural; the gate)
registered_forecasts.Q2: repaired family attains a HIGHER final training objective than the defective family in >= 15 of 18 matched conditions
registered_forecasts.Q3: repaired family's measured additional A/SEX recovery is NOT worse than the defective family's at matched rank/policy in >= 2 of 3 seeds
registered_forecasts.Q4: repaired family still fails the primary point-estimate coordination rule against both L1 and L2 in every cell
registered_forecasts.Q5: repaired best candidate remains significantly worse than J on A/SEX under at least one weighting
registered_forecasts.Q6: LEACE baseline: near-zero LINEAR recovery from the transformed channel alone, but selected additional recovery from the augmented A wire stays above zero
registered_forecasts.Q7: at least one external adaptation proves to be an alias or infeasible and is credited-and-reused or reported scoped-infeasible rather than refitted

scope.2017: development for these new methods, labelled so; original locked study keeps its historical status
scope.2016: NOT scored, fitted, transformed, tuned on, or inspected. Remains UNSCORED.
